name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
benefit: ₹6,000 per year directly transferred to bank account in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land holdings in their names, subject to exclusions.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Land Record Details (Khasra/Khatauni), Bank Passbook linked with Aadhaar.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefit: Comprehensive crop loss protection against drought, flood, pests, unseasonal rain. Farmer premium only 1.5% for Rabi, 2% for Kharif, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
documents: Land possession certificate, sowing certificate from Patwari/Gram Sevak, Aadhaar, Bank Details.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Per Drop More Crop)
benefit: Up to 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers on Drip & Sprinkler irrigation systems.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land with an assured water source (borewell/canal/open well).
documents: Soil/water test report, land revenue records, identity proof, quotation from empanelled drip supplier.
status: Applications Open through State Horticulture Portals

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free comprehensive 12-parameter soil testing (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) with customized crop-specific fertilizer recommendations.
documents: Basic farmer details, land survey number, soil sample submitted to nearest KVK or Block Agriculture Office.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
benefit: Collateral-free credit limit up to ₹1.6 Lakhs (up to ₹3 Lakhs with prompt repayment incentive at effective 4% interest rate per annum).
eligibility: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, Self Help Groups (SHGs) of farmers.
documents: Duly filled application form, proof of land cultivation, photo ID, address proof.
status: Available at all Commercial, Cooperative & RRB Banks

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Agricultural Pumps)
benefit: 60% direct subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) for standalone solar water pumps and solarizing grid-connected agricultural pumps.
eligibility: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, cooperatives, water user associations with farmland needing irrigation pump.
documents: Farmland records, Aadhaar card, electricity connection copy (for solarization), bank passbook.
status: Active across states via Renewable Energy Agencies (e.g. MEDA, HAREDA, RREC)

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
benefit: 40% to 50% subsidy on purchase of Tractors, Power Tillers, Rotavators, Harvesters, Drone Sprayers, and Laser Land Levellers.
eligibility: Farmers of all categories, priority given to small, marginal, SC/ST, and women farmers.
documents: Land record, Aadhaar card, caste certificate (if applicable), bank passbook, quotation from authorized dealer.
